description: Multiple agents review in parallel, then synthesize findings

tasks.task:
Review the implementation for security vulnerabilities:

{{goal}}

Focus on:
- Input validation and sanitization
- Authentication and authorization
- Data exposure risks
- Dependency vulnerabilities
- Injection attacks (SQL, command, etc.)

Review the implementation for performance issues:

{{goal}}

Focus on:
- Algorithmic complexity
- Memory usage patterns
- Database query efficiency
- Network call optimization
- Caching opportunities
acceptance_criteria: No O(n^2) or worse algorithms on large inputs

tasks.task:
Review the implementation for code quality:

{{goal}}

Focus on:
- Readability and naming
- SOLID principles adherence
- Error handling patterns
- Test coverage and quality
- Documentation completeness
acceptance_criteria: Tests are meaningful, not just coverage

tasks.task:
Synthesize the three review findings (security, performance, code-quality) for:

{{goal}}

Produce a final report that:
- Prioritizes findings by severity
- Resolves any conflicting recommendations
- Creates an actionable improvement list
- Identifies which issues are blocking vs. advisory
acceptance_criteria: Priorities are assigned to each finding
Blocking vs. advisory issues are clearly separated
